subject: general
question: The Companies (Amendment) Bill, 2020 was introduced in Lok Sabha by which minister?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Anurag Singh Thakur**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Anurag Singh Thakur:-**

 
 
• Anurag Singh Thakur is an Indian politician who is serving as the Union Minister of Information & Broadcasting and Youth Affairs & Sports in the Second Modi ministry.
 
• He is a member of the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) and has been representing the Hamirpur constituency in the Lok Sabha since 2008.
 
• He introduced The Companies (Amendment) Bill, 2020.
 
• In the 16th Lok Sabha, Thakur served as the Chief Whip of the BJP.
 
• He was the youngest MP to have ever been appointed Chief Whip.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ramesh Bidhuri:-**

 
 
• He is a two-term Member of Parliament (MP) from the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP), representing the South Delhi constituency.
 
• He is also the Chairman of the Petroleum and Natural Gas Committee in the Lok Sabha.
 
 
 
• **Nitin Gadkari:-**
 
 
• He is an Indian politician who is the current Minister for Road Transport & Highways in the Government of India.
 
• He is also the longest serving Minister for Road Transport & Highways currently running his tenure for over 9 years. 
 
 
 
• **Gautam Gambhir:-**
 
 
• He is a former Indian cricketer and a current Member of Parliament.
 
• He is known for his aggressive and reliable batting, and his strong leadership skills.
